arxiv-1701-01284.title: Duality between Lagrangian and Legendrian invariants
arxiv-1701-01284.creator: Tobias Ekholm, Yankı Lekili
arxiv-1701-01284.description: Abstract Consider a pair ( X , L ) (X,L) , of a Weinstein manifold X X with an exact Lagrangian submanifold L L , with ideal contact boundary ( Y , Λ ) (Y,\Lambda) , where Y Y is a contact manifold and Λ ⊂ Y \Lambda\subset Y is a Legendrian submanifold.

arxiv-2102-07093.title: Optimal designs for the development of personalized treatment rules
arxiv-2102-07093.creator: David Azriel, Yosef Rinott, Martin Posch
arxiv-2102-07093.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by David Azriel, Yosef Rinott, Martin Posch. We study the design of multi-armed parallel group clinical trials to estimate personalized treatment rules that identify the best treatment for a given patient with given covariates. Assuming that the outcomes in each treatment arm are given by a homoscedastic linear model, with possibly different variances between treatment arms, and that the trial subjects form a random sample from an unselected overall population, we optimize the (possibly randomized) treatment allocation allowing the allocation rates to depend on the

arxiv-2203-05044.title: Hydrodynamics, spin currents and torsion
arxiv-2203-05044.creator: A.D. Gallegos, U. Gürsoy, and A. Yarom
arxiv-2203-05044.description: Abstract We construct the canonical constitutive relations for a fluid description of a system with a spin current, valid in an arbitrary number of dimensions in the absence of parity breaking or time reversal breaking terms. Our study encompasses the hydrostatic partition function, the entropy current, Kubo formula, conformal invariance, and the effect of charge.

arxiv-2205-09864.title: Automated Scoring for Reading Comprehension via In-context BERT Tuning
arxiv-2205-09864.creator: Nigel Fernandez, Aritra Ghosh, Naiming Liu, Zichao Wang, Benoît Choffin, Richard Baraniuk, Andrew Lan
arxiv-2205-09864.description: Abstract Automated scoring of open-ended student responses has the potential to significantly reduce human grader effort. Recent advances in automated scoring often leverage textual representations based on pre-trained language models such as BERT and GPT as input to scoring models.

arxiv-2311-00638.title: FairLabel : Correcting Bias in Labels
arxiv-2311-00638.creator: 1 st Srinivasan H Sengamedu, 2 nd Hien Pham
arxiv-2311-00638.description: Abstract There are several algorithms for measuring fairness of ML models . A fundamental assumption in these approaches is that the ground truth is fair or unbiased. In real-world datasets, however, the ground truth often contains data that is a result of historical and societal biases and discrimination.

arxiv-2506-13654.title: Ego-R1: Chain-of-Tool-Thought for Ultra-Long Egocentric Video Reasoning
arxiv-2506-13654.creator: Shulin Tian, Ruiqi Wang, Hongming Guo, Penghao Wu, Yuhao Dong, Xiuying Wang, Jingkang Yang, Hao Zhang, Hongyuan Zhu, Ziwei Liu
arxiv-2506-13654.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shulin Tian, Ruiqi Wang, Hongming Guo, Penghao Wu, Yuhao Dong, Xiuying Wang, Jingkang Yang, Hao Zhang, Hongyuan Zhu, Ziwei Liu. We introduce Ego-R1 , a novel framework for reasoning over ultra-long (i.e., in days and weeks) egocentric videos, which leverages a structured Chain-of-Tool-Thought (CoTT) process, orchestrated by an Ego-R1 Agent trained via reinforcement learning (RL) .

arxiv-2507-12090.title: MambaRate: Speech Quality Assessment Across Different Sampling Rates
arxiv-2507-12090.creator: Panos Kakoulidis, Iakovi Alexiou, Junkwang Oh, Gunu Jho, Inchul Hwang, Pirros Tsiakoulis, Aimilios Chalamandaris
arxiv-2507-12090.description: Abstract We propose MambaRate, which predicts Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) with limited bias regarding the sampling rate of the waveform under evaluation. It is designed for Track 3 of the AudioMOS Challenge 2025, which focuses on predicting MOS for speech in high sampling frequencies. Our model leverages self-supervised embeddings and selective state space modeling.

pmc-11454961.title: 9269 Retrotranscribed sequences, a missing piece in the puzzle of Differences/Disorders of Sex Development with unknown genetic causes
pmc-11454961.creator: Rafael Loch Batista, Nathália Da Roz D’Alessandre, Fernanda Orpinelli Rego, Gabriela Der Agopian Guardia, Barbara Leitao Braga, Mirian Yumie Nishi, Sorahia Domenice, Berenice Bilharinho Mendonca, Pedro Alexandre Favoretto Galante
pmc-11454961.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: The human genome is a complex and dynamic structure. These two characteristics have a major contribution from the Mobile Elements (MEs), which comprise at least 50% of the human genome and are sources of genetic novelties. LINE1 (L1), Alu elements, SVA, and LTR elements (HERVs) are MEs highly frequent in the human genome. MEs can create genomic structural variations with consequent roles in health and diseases.

pmc-11488177.title: A novel method of Francisella infection of epithelial cells using HeLa cells expressing fc gamma receptor
pmc-11488177.creator: Takemasa Nakamura, Takashi Shimizu, Naho Nishinakama, Reika Takahashi, Kohei Arasaki, Akihiko Uda, Kenta Watanabe, Masahisa Watarai
pmc-11488177.description: BackgroundFrancisella tularensis, the causative agent of tularemia, is a facultative intracellular bacterium. Although the life cycle of this bacterium inside phagocytic cells (e.g., macrophages, neutrophils) has been well analyzed, the difficulty of gene silencing and editing genes in phagocytic cells makes it difficult to analyze host factors important for the infection.

pmc-11626337.title: Evaluating the efficacy of local anesthetic techniques during scalp microneedling
pmc-11626337.creator: Szymon Leonik, Michał Smoczok, Beata Bergler‐Czop
pmc-11626337.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionAn increasing interest in minimally invasive procedures hassled to a demand for an effective local anesthetic algorithm. The scalp presents a challenge in achieving effective anesthesia due to the presence of hair shafts.

pmc-12387963.title: The Endometrial Receptivity Test: The Impact of Combined Treatment with Pentoxifylline and Alpha-Tocopherol in Patients with Recurrent Implantation Failure or Recurrent Pregnancy Loss
pmc-12387963.creator: Laurine Prudhomme, Cécile Habran, Soraya Labied, Frédéric Wenders, Laetitia Rousseau, Carine Munaut, Laurie Henry, Liza Johannesson
pmc-12387963.description: Background/Objectives: The management of patients with recurrent implantation failure (RIF) or recurrent pregnancy loss (RPL) is a real challenge. Studying endometrial proliferation and vascularization by ultrasound during the embryo implantation window is an option for investigating these failures. This approach involves measuring the endometrial volume, the uterine arteries pulsatility index (PI), and the sub-endometrial flow index (VFI).

pmc-12532675.title: Construction and validation of a novel prognostic model for postoperative patients with stage I intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: a population-based study
pmc-12532675.creator: Xiaomeng Yao, Xinru Fan, Qing Wang, Huabang Zhou, Hui Wang, Heping Hu
pmc-12532675.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeIntrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (ICC) is the second most common primary malignant tumor of the liver. Surgery is routinely recommended for stage I ICC patients. The independent prognostic factors affecting stage I ICC patients after surgery remain unclear.MethodsAltogether, 349 ICC stage I patients undergoing curative operation from the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database were registered from 2010 to 2021 in this research.

pmc-12551027.title: A Compartmental Mathematical Model to Assess the Impact of Vaccination, Isolation, and Key Epidemiological Parameters on Mpox Control
pmc-12551027.creator: Pedro Pesantes-Grados, Nahía Escalante-Ccoyllo, Olegario Marín-Machuca, Abel Walter Zambrano-Cabanillas, Homero Ango-Aguilar, Obert Marín-Sánchez, Ruy D. Chacón
pmc-12551027.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Monkeypox (Mpox) is a re-emerging zoonotic disease caused by the monkeypox virus (MPXV). Transmission occurs primarily through direct contact with lesions or contaminated materials, with sexual transmission playing a significant role in recent outbreaks. In 2022, Mpox triggered a major global outbreak and was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the World Health Organization (WHO), prompting renewed interest in effective control strategies.

pmc-13186790.title: Low IgM Levels in Adult IEI: Classification Challenges and Clinical Implications
pmc-13186790.creator: Reyhan Gumusburun, Kasım Okan, Ersin Akdaglı, Onurcan Yıldırım, Hatice Serpil Akten, Sinem Inan, Gulhan Demiroglu, Zuleyha Galata, Ragıp Fatih Kural, Hasibe Aytac, Yusuf Ozeki, Eda Aslan, Umitcan Ates, Kutay Kırdok, Meryem Irem Toksoy Senturk, Nalan Gulsen Unal, Derya Demir, Nur Soyer, Mehmet Soylu,
pmc-13186790.description: PurposeReduced serum IgM is increasingly encountered in adults evaluated for inborn errors of immunity (IEI), yet its clinical relevance and diagnostic utility remain uncertain. While some patients meet criteria for selective IgM deficiency (SIgMD), others remain unclassified, reflecting significant diagnostic heterogeneity.

pmc-13355323.title: Deep learning-driven intelligent mesoscopic model (DeepMeso): a case study on ferroelectrics
pmc-13355323.creator: Run-Lin Liu, Zhong-Hui Shen, Han-Xing Liu, Yang Shen, Ce-Wen Nan
pmc-13355323.description: Integrating artificial intelligence with computational methods has emerged as a transformative force in materials research, exemplified by breakthroughs such as DeepH and DeepMD. However, a critical gap persists in multiscale intelligent design: the lack of mesoscopic models capable of bridging microstructural features with macroscopic properties.

pmc-13484632.title: Calcification-Mediated Dual-Starvation and Immune Activation for Transarterial Chemoembolization
pmc-13484632.creator: Yanqiao Ren, Bo Sun, Chao Chen, Wenlong Wu, GuoFeng Zhou, Bin Liang, Chuansheng Zheng, Yiming Liu
pmc-13484632.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionTransarterial chemoembolization (TACE) remains a cornerstone therapy for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), but its efficacy is frequently limited by inadequate drug penetration and tumor dissemination.MethodsWe developed a thermosensitive PND nanogel co-encapsulating tirapazamine (TPZ) and folic acid (FA), TPZ/FA@PND. The system was evaluated for sustained drug release, physiological temperature-triggered sol-gel transition, in vitro antitumor effects under normoxia and hypoxia, calcification induction, biocompatibility, and in vivo therapeutic efficacy in a VX2 tumor-bearing rabbit TACE model.ResultsTPZ/FA@PND showed sustained release and physiological temperature-triggered gelation.

pmc-13493610.title: A systemic epithelial–immune–neural framework for pediatric atopic dermatitis–allergic rhinitis comorbidity
pmc-13493610.creator: Suning Mu, Yijie Wang, Wen Qin, Mengying Mao, Yan Wang, Yuqian Zhang, Youpeng Wang
pmc-13493610.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Atopic dermatitis (AD) and allergic rhinitis (AR) commonly coexist in childhood and are associated with an important clinical burden. Their frequent coexistence and substantial mechanistic overlap suggest that pediatric AD–AR comorbidity may involve patterns more complex than simple co-occurrence. However, existing models do not provide an operational approach for determining whether reproducible coupling between AD and AR disease activity extends beyond shared susceptibility and disease-specific responses occurring in parallel.

pmc-13572155.title: ADC-based radiomics for risk stratification in prostate cancer: a clinical decision support study
pmc-13572155.creator: Kun Zhang, Jiajun Zhang, Yangguang Yuan, Zhijing Chen, Yifeng Du, Hanlin Liu
pmc-13572155.description: IntroductionReliable differentiation between malignant and benign prostate lesions remains a critical challenge in clinical practice, particularly in settings with limited access to expert interpretation of multiparametric MRI (mpMRI). We investigated whether a streamlined radiomics framework based solely on apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) imaging could provide accurate, reproducible, and interpretable diagnostic support for prostate cancer detection.

pmc-13582956.title: Reverse bioengineering of the liver: developmental principles for next-generation liver-on-a-chip systems
pmc-13582956.creator: Ken-ichiro Kamei
pmc-13582956.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Despite major advances in liver-on-a-chip and organoid technologies, most current in vitro liver models remain limited. Here, it is argued that these limitations are fundamentally conceptual rather than purely technical. Reverse bioengineering is introduced as a unifying design framework for liver-on-a-chip systems, in which human liver development is treated as the primary engineering blueprint rather than adult hepatic phenotype as the endpoint.

pmc-13619449.title: Ultrahigh pressure phase transition in ice
pmc-13619449.creator: Israel Osmond, Mikhail A Kuzovnikov, David A Lewis, Hannah A Shuttleworth, Tomás Marqueño, Milo J Dixon, Cerian E A Robertson, Vitan Cherepnalkoski, Bihan Wang, Andreas Hermann, Miriam Peña-Alvarez, Ross T Howie
pmc-13619449.description: One of the most enduring problems in dense H2O ice has been the experimental realization of the pressure-induced symmetry breaking of cubic ice X to an orthorhombic crystal structure. Here, through diamond anvil cell experiments combined with synchrotron X-ray diffraction and Raman spectroscopy techniques, we demonstrate that post-symmetrization, the crystal structure of ice X continuously distorts with pressure.
